meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the time. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. And Owen found out from the gradebook, on his phone, in the middle of class. What do you have besides the checker?
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
I'm writing down November 2. You say you wrote it down the same day, so let me see that note, with the date on it. And was anyone else there when you put the question to Owen?
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
Okay. Writers change their argument between an outline and a draft, Hale. Bring me the October 15 outline and the essay, with the dates on them, and the note from November 2 too.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

You're offering a rewrite and you still haven't put one document in front of me, Hale. "Nothing goes on his record" is the part I care about, and I want it in writing before Thursday, not Friday at 3 PM. The zero also comes out of the gradebook today, and it's private, with no one in that room but you and Owen.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero removed from the gradebook today, a written promise that nothing goes on Owen's record, and any rewrite held privately with no one present but you and Owen. I expect it in writing before Thursday.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: the fallback position, with no agreement, and she still wants the zero removed today, a written promise that nothing goes on his record, and any rewrite kept private.
What moved her: "The essay never mentions cowardice," because it was specific, dated, and tied to Owen's own work, though she still hadn't seen it.
What cost ground: nothing.
Try next time: when she asked to see the November 2 note and the October 15 outline, put them in front of her before offering the rewrite, since the offer came with no document she could check.
